responses.text: {Player in NCR gear} I don't know what you did to pull runner duty to a post this far out in the wasteland, but you have my sympathies.
{Player not in NCR gear} If you're here to sell something, we don't want any.
You think I haven't tried? Every time I do, Camp Golf acknowledges the situation. And soon after that, more ammo.

topics.prompt: Why don't you use your radio to fix your supply situation?

responses.text: We're not going to die of thirst any time soon, but I'd rather have too much than not enough.

topics.prompt: How are your water supplies right now?

responses.text: Eh, it's not my call to make. You'd have to clear it with Ranger Ericsen.

topics.prompt: Since you have extra, could I have some of that ammo?

responses.text: No problem. Hey, do me a favor when you get back to Reyes and tell her that we don't need any more damn ammo. Wouldn't mind more water, though.

topics.prompt: Sergeant Reyes sent me here. I've got a security update for your radio.

responses.text: This is the frontier of NCR territory, and we're the first line of defense. You won't find much in the way of civilization east of here.
South of here is Camp Guardian, but they've been having radio trouble so they've been silent for awhile now.

topics.prompt: What do you do out here?

responses.text: We keep getting deliveries of ammunition for some reason. I don't mind target practice, but there isn't all that much to shoot at out here.

topics.prompt: What was that about the surplus ammo?
